images.title: The rabbit between two tens
images.purpose: Show the rabbit at 2,346 with food at the neighbouring tens 2,340 and 2,350 and the jumps to each.
images.composition: A short horizontal number line with a rabbit, two food bowls and jump arcs, centred on white.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal number line with 11 equally spaced ticks from 2,340 to 2,350. The tick at 2,340 is labelled 2,340 with a bowl of carrots above it. The tick at 2,350 is labelled 2,350 with a bowl of carrots above it. A friendly rabbit stands on the tick for 2,346, labelled 2,346. Four small arcs in #0072B2 run from the rabbit to the 2,350 bowl, labelled '4 jumps'. Six small arcs in #6B7280 run from the rabbit to the 2,340 bowl, labelled '6 jumps'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The nearest ten is the bowl with fewer jumps.
